items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer states 'I met him in St. Louis' and describes him as a 'Beautiful trumpet player', but the interviewee (Joe Thomas) does not claim any personal interaction or relationship with James Oliver Cobb.

ctx.x: Yeah. I met him in St. Louis. Beautiful trumpet player. James Oliver Cobb, Baby Jane, I don't remember all.
